name: Alexis
source:
Raised in a rich family, Alexis is the heir to the Summerset Dutchy. She is known for her kindness towards others, and her resolve to gain as much knowledge as she can. Some say there is a darker side to her, but nothing has been confirmed by reports.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
